sections.title: Sound of ir
paragraphs: The letters ir make the main sound /ɜːr/, as in (bird) /bɜːrd/, which means bird. These letters have three sounds.

sections.title: How to say ir
paragraphs: For the first sound, keep your mouth half open, curl your tongue back slightly, and voice the sound. For the second sound, relax your tongue and lips completely, making a very short vowel. For the third sound, open wide, move to a smile, then curl your tongue back. Feel your vocal cords buzz in your throat for all three.

sections.title: Spelling of ir
paragraphs: In stressed syllables, ir makes the sound /ɜːr/, as in (shirt) /ʃɜːrt/. In unstressed syllables, ir makes the short sound /ər/, as in (elixir) /ɪ.lɪk.sər/. Before a silent e, ir makes the sound /aɪ.ər/, as in (fire) /faɪ.ər/ and (wire) /waɪ.ər/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not roll your tongue when you say these sounds. Keep your tongue steady inside your mouth without tapping your teeth. Do not swap the long sound with a pure vowel like the sound in cat or pot. Always let the vowel blend smoothly into the r sound.
